body:
Confirmed apps2/battlegrounds_gui's C HTTP client has zero TLS capability on either build target. Per spec §7's own sanctioned fallback and founder's live choice, disabled the plaintext email+password GUI login path (three-layer gate: UI, input handling, and the network call site itself) rather than rush an unvetted TLS implementation. SIGN UP (browser-based, real TLS) unaffected. Live-verified via native build + Xvfb screenshot. Commit dc293b6.

⚓ ☃
title: SSH Transport & Identity spec Stage 2: GUI login disabled pending TLS
